description: This file defines the SwfException class for handling exceptions related to AWS Simple Workflow Service in the AWS SDK for PHP.

classes.name: SwfException
classes.description: An exception class representing errors interacting with the Amazon Simple Workflow Service (SWF). It extends the AwsException class to inherit general AWS exception handling features.

methods.name: SwfException
methods.description: Constructor for the SwfException class, inherited from AwsException. It initializes the exception object.
